description:
You are one of several procurement officers at a hospital network choosing a vendor for a new patient-records system. Each officer has reviewed different parts of the bids and reference checks.

The options are:
- Vendor A (Anstirke Negar)
- Vendor B (Quogar Belwelri)
- Vendor C (Quoheskquo Oznolso)
- Vendor D (Belpolith Nesanith)

Exactly one option is best overall. Which vendor should be selected? Your notes are incomplete: other participants hold information you do not have.

agents.shard_text:
Vendor A (Anstirke Negar):
  - Vendor A had a pilot cancelled at a peer hospital
  - Vendor A offers 24/7 on-call support
  - Vendor A has reported financial difficulties
  - Vendor A estimates deployment will take 5 months
  - Vendor A reported 9 major outages last year
Vendor B (Quogar Belwelri):
  - Vendor B offers support only during business hours
  - Vendor B supports standard interoperability formats
  - Vendor B quoted a total cost of 347 thousand per year
  - Vendor B reported 7 major outages last year
Vendor C (Quoheskquo Oznolso):
  - Vendor C has high engineering staff turnover
  - Vendor C meets accessibility standards
  - Vendor C performs encrypted off-site backups
  - Vendor C has unresolved compliance findings
  - Vendor C reported 5 major outages last year
Vendor D (Belpolith Nesanith):
  - Vendor D has no published product roadmap
  - Vendor D charges extra for data migration
  - Vendor D has strong references from similar hospitals
  - Vendor D completed a successful pilot at a peer hospital
  - Vendor D currently serves 4 hospital clients
